title: Let There Be Light
status: Two original synthetic vocal choices + instrumental
description: An original song adaptation inspired by Genesis 1, with an intentionally robotic synthetic vocal draft and an instrumental version. The reference Scripture is the public-domain Berean Standard Bible.

sections.label: Day one · Light
lines: Before the dawn, before the day,
The earth lay dark, without a form.
God’s Spirit moved above the deep;
God spoke, and light began to dawn.

sections.label: Day two · Sky
lines: God spoke, and stretched the sky above,
Between the waters, wide and high.
The evening passed, the morning came;
A second day beneath the sky.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let there be light, let there be light;
The Maker speaks, the world awakes.
And all He made was very good;
We sing the wonder of His works.

sections.label: Day three · Land and life
lines: The waters drew to seas below;
The dry land rose where grass would grow.
Each tree bore fruit, each plant its seed;
God saw the good in all that grew.

sections.label: Day four · Sun, moon and stars
lines: The greater light would rule the day;
The lesser light would rule the night.
The stars would shine, the seasons turn;
God filled the heavens with their light.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let there be light, let there be light;
The Maker speaks, the world awakes.
And all He made was very good;
We sing the wonder of His works.

sections.label: Day five · Sea and sky
lines: The waters teemed with living things;
The birds took flight across the sky.
God blessed their life to fill the seas,
To spread their wings and multiply.

sections.label: Day six · Life on earth
lines: God made the creatures of the earth,
And in His image, woman, man.
He blessed them, gave the earth to tend,
And plants for food across the land.

rights.composition: New lyrics, melody and synthesized arrangement prepared for Bible Songs. No external recordings or samples used.
rights.vocal: Rendered locally with the free eSpeak formant synthesizer and original note timing/DSP. Not a human voice recording or voice clone. No paid APIs used.
rights.adaptation: These song lyrics are an adaptation, not the verbatim Berean Standard Bible chapter.
rights.warmVocal: Kokoro-82M standard af_heart voice (Apache-2.0 model), run locally with kokoro-onnx (MIT), then processed with original singing DSP. No singer audio input, cloning or fine-tuning.
rights.compositeVocal: Pretrained Matcha-TTS/VCTK acoustic model and HiFi-GAN vocoder; speaker embeddings locally adapted on a selected LibriTTS-R subset, averaged across eight profiles, then original singing DSP. Machine-generated output. See voice4-credits.md for attribution and changes. Revised in 1.0.8 using local Praat/Parselmouth pulse-synchronous overlap-add, voicing-aware timing, syllable-note contours and echo-free mixing.
rights.voice3: Local Matcha-TTS full speech-model fine-tuning on a LibriTTS-R training set; checkpoint 500; mean of 124 male-labelled speaker embeddings; original word timing/PSOLA processing. Machine-generated; not singing-trained. Attribution and changes: voice3-credits.md. Revised in 1.0.7 with local Praat/Parselmouth pulse-synchronous overlap-add, voicing-aware timing, syllable-level notes and echo-free mixing.

recordings.name: Classic synthetic
recordings.description: A deliberately robotic, bright formant-synthesis voice. This is the unchanged original vocal.
recordings.creation: Created locally with the free eSpeak synthesizer. Each word was fitted to the original melody using pitch and timing adjustments, then mixed with our instrumental track. It uses no singer recording, voice clone or paid service.

recordings.name: Warm expressive
recordings.description: A warmer neural voice with shaped phrases, restrained vibrato and more dynamic contrast. Still an experimental synthetic singing draft.
recordings.creation: Started with the freely licensed Kokoro speech model’s standard af_heart voice, rendered on this computer. Original processing sustains its vowels to the melody, preserves consonant edges and adds phrase dynamics and light vibrato. It was not trained on the top ten singers or made to copy an identifiable performer; no paid service was used.

recordings.name: Voice 3 · Clear ensemble
recordings.description: A composite neural voice with more melodic movement, preserved consonant timing and an echo-free mix. Experimental synthetic singing.
recordings.creation: Uses the same locally fine-tuned Matcha-TTS speech model and 124-profile composite as before. The revised recording uses free Praat processing to follow the voice’s pulses, retain unvoiced consonants and give voiced sounds more of the sustained duration. It follows each syllable’s melody note for a livelier delivery, avoids per-word volume pumping, and removes the short echo and added vibrato. This is processed synthetic speech, not a human singer or a singing-trained model; the speech sources and tools are credited below. The line “God’s Spirit moved above the deep” now uses phoneme-aware timing to protect consonants and gives “Spirit” a little extra emphasis.

recordings.name: Voice 4 · Resonant composite
recordings.description: A resonant composite timbre with more melodic movement, clearer consonant timing and an echo-free mix. Experimental synthetic singing.
recordings.creation: Retains the free Matcha-TTS speech model and eight adapted speaker profiles averaged into one composite voice. The revised vocal uses local Praat processing to follow the voice’s pulses and keep unvoiced consonants close to their original timing while voiced sounds sustain the notes. It follows each syllable’s melody for a livelier delivery, uses gentler phrase-level gain, and removes the short echo and added vibrato. This is synthetic speech processed into song, not a separately trained singer; no paid service was used. The line “God’s Spirit moved above the deep” now uses phoneme-aware timing to protect consonants and gives “Spirit” a little extra emphasis.

recordings.name: Instrumental only
recordings.description: Hear the original melody and accompaniment without a vocal.
recordings.creation: Created directly from our original note sequence using local waveform synthesis. The editable MIDI is included. No external recordings, samples or paid tools were used.
